chat.title: Search
chat.greeting: Describe the hotel in words. I will find where it is true and show you why on the map.
chat.hint: Enter sends, Shift and Enter add a line
chat.errorText: Could not continue the conversation. Send the message again.
chat.startTitle: Search in words. Check on the map.
chat.startText: Quiet nights, a sunset view, the walk to the sea. We find hotels where it is backed by data and show the proof on the map.
chat.example1: a quiet room with a sunset view, a short walk to the sea
chat.example2: a hotel in the centre near the promenade and cafes
chat.example3: dogs welcome, a park nearby for walks
